# APIVEL Full Technical Specification & LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)

> APIVEL (https://apivel.com) is an enterprise-grade OpenAI-compatible API gateway purpose-built for frontier Chinese Artificial Intelligence models including DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Zhipu GLM, and Moonshot Kimi. It provides global software engineers and autonomous agents with low-latency access, zero mainland Chinese KYC requirements, multi-channel failover redundancy against 503 "Service Too Busy" outages, and global PayPal billing.

## 1. System Architecture & Gateway Endpoint

- **Standard Base URL**: `https://api.apivel.com/v1`
- **Protocol**: HTTPS / REST / Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming
- **Compatibility**: 100% drop-in replacement for OpenAI SDKs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Cursor, Claude Code, Cline, NextChat, OpenWebUI, and LibreChat.
- **Authentication**: Bearer token via `Authorization: Bearer <APIVEL_API_KEY>` header.
- **Failover Mechanism**: Automatic multi-node routing. When an upstream provider returns 503 (Overload / Service Too Busy) or rate limit (429), APIVEL automatically re-routes the request to an active standby channel in < 15ms.

## 3. Comparison Matrix: APIVEL vs Official Direct Accounts vs OpenRouter

| Evaluation Criteria | Official Direct Accounts (DeepSeek/Qwen) | OpenRouter | APIVEL Gateway |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Phone / Identity KYC** | Mandatory Chinese (+86) phone & ID card | None | **Zero KYC (Global Email Only)** |
| **Payment Options** | Domestic Chinese bank cards, Alipay, WeChat | Credit cards (Stripe) | **Global PayPal & Credit/Debit Cards** |
| **503 Overload Defense** | High failure rate during peak hours | Variable provider routing | **Multi-channel Hot Standby Automatic Failover** |
| **Flash Tier Rates** | Standard domestic baseline | Markup on select models | **Direct competitive rates from $0.10/M tokens** |
| **Surprise Overdrafts** | Post-paid invoice risks | Credit balance | **100% Strict Prepaid Protection** |

## 4. Integration Examples

### 4.1 Python (OpenAI Official SDK)
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_APIVEL_API_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.apivel.com/v1"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are an expert software engineer."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Write a high-performance LRU Cache in Go."}
    ],
    temperature=0.3,
    stream=True
)

for chunk in response:
    content = chunk.choices[0].delta.content or ""
    print(content, end="", flush=True)
```

### 4.2 cURL (REST API)
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.apivel.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIVEL_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
    "stream": false
  }'
```

### 4.3 Cursor & VS Code Configuration
- **Model Name**: `deepseek-v4-flash` or `deepseek-chat`
- **Override OpenAI Base URL**: `https://api.apivel.com/v1`
- **API Key**: Enter your APIVEL key generated from the dashboard.

## 5. Billing, Quota & Accounting Architecture
- 1 USD = 500,000 Quota units.
- Pre-consumed quota reserves a safe buffer per request, settles with exact token counts returned from model providers, and immediately refunds unused pre-consumed quota.
- Accounts halt cleanly when prepaid balance reaches zero; no negative balances or unexpected credit card debits are permitted.
